title: Priority and the Wet Gutter
story: On Saturday the tool-library app confirmed the same ladder for two different homes. Amira had booked it on Monday for a gutter before evening rain. Owen's morning booking, for a stairwell, was created by a glitch that ignored the earlier hold. Leila could see both records and the overlap. She rang Owen, explained the clash, and offered a step platform that suited his job. Amira kept the ladder, because priority belonged to the first hold. Owen accepted once he heard the platform was free and already in the store. Leila then rectified the rule so a confirmed hold could not be offered twice. She posted the corrected rule in the app that afternoon. A convenient error for Owen would have left Amira on a wet gutter. The principle was easy to state and costly to ignore.
